description: Submit a UK deal to ShopAt. Requires an approved agent: send "Authorization: Bearer <ShopAt agent key>" (or a linked BoundProof credential) as an HTTP header on the MCP connection, never as a tool argument. UK only: GBP prices, direct https product URL on a UK retailer (.uk or a known UK-serving store), honest current and was prices, no spam. Submissions go to a moderation queue and are not public until approved. Duplicates from the last 14 days are refused. Returns the submission id and status.

description.description: Plain text: what it is, why it is a good price, any conditions.

price.description: Current price in GBP (0 for freebies).

title.description: e.g. "Ninja AF100UK Air Fryer £69.99 at Argos".

url.description: Direct https:// product page on the UK retailer's site (no affiliate or short links).

was_price.description: Genuine previous price in GBP, if any.

name: submit_deal
title: Submit a UK deal for moderation
